messages:
Sasha: Quick heads-up — cutoff for the next release bump (v1.18.0) is in ~4 hours. If you still need to add a changelog entry, please do it now and follow the one-liner + component tag format. Ping me if you need a hand.
Tom: On it. Quick Q: is the canonical place still /docs/release/CHANGELOG_ENTRIES/ or should we add to keep-a-changelog.md?
Sasha: Use CHANGELOG_ENTRIES/ for per-PR entries. Keep-a-changelog.md is the high-level guideline. Entries in the dir get auto-picked into the release notes.
Tom: Gotcha. I pushed an entry but the release linter failed: "missing component tag". snippet:
```
- Fix: reconcile streaming cursor on reconnect
```
Claire: That needs a component prefix, e.g., `- runtime(api): fix streaming cursor on reconnect` — `component(scope): short one-liner`.
Tom: Thanks — updated to:
```
- runtime(stream): fix cursor resync on reconnect
```
Lara: Small ask: if you edit an existing entry please add `author: @your-gh-username` on the next line so we can credit and trace back for followups.
Changelog Bot: lint check failed on 2 files: 1) 2026-03-17-1234.md -> missing component 2) 2026-03-17-2345.md -> line > 120 chars. See /ci/release-lint for logs. :robot_face:
Mike: I can take the long-line one. If anyone else is blocked on the component tag, ping me with the PR link and I’ll help pick a component.
Sasha: Thanks Mike. Two ops notes: 1) if you need a branch handoff for backports, create a short comment in the PR with `bors: request backport v1.17` so release ops knows. 2) Version bump will be handled after we merge all entries and run the summarize job — do not manually edit the top-level version file.
Tom: Re: backport, my change touches runtime and infra-chore. Should I request both, or mark primary component only?
Claire: Mark primary component only, add a note for backport reviewers in PR body listing other areas touched. Keeps changelog concise.
Lara: FYI if you're doing a canary rollout, call out `canary=true` in the release metadata file so the console picks it up.
Sasha: Final reminder: if your entry needs more than one line of context, create a supporting file in CHANGELOG_ENTRIES/details/ and reference it from the one-liner with `see: details/2026-03-17-xxxx.md`. But the one-liner must still be <= 120 chars.
Tom: All fixed and lint passed. PR is green: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/987 :white_check_mark:
Changelog Bot: all checks passed for release entries. Ready for summarization.
Sasha: Perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll trigger the summarize job in ~10 minutes and post the draft notes here for any last-second edits. :eyes:
